Terms of use

The agreement between you and Hundy.

Last updated: 2026-09-29

The agreement

These terms are an agreement between you and Nexoma Labs LLC, which publishes Hundy. By downloading or using Hundy you accept them; if you do not, please do not use the app. The privacy policy explains how your data is handled and forms part of these terms.

What Hundy is

Hundy is a fitness tracking app that counts push-up repetitions using your device camera. It is provided for general fitness and training purposes.

Who can use Hundy

Hundy is designed for adults. If you are under 18, or under the age of majority where you live, use it only with the permission and supervision of a parent or guardian.

Hundy is not medical advice

Rep counts, quality scores and form cues are training aids, not clinical assessments. Hundy is not a medical device. It cannot diagnose an injury, judge whether an exercise is safe for you, or replace a qualified coach or clinician. Consult a professional before starting a new training programme, especially if you are pregnant, injured or have a medical condition, and stop if you feel pain, dizziness or shortness of breath.

Train safely

You are responsible for your own safety and for your surroundings. Clear enough space around you, place your phone where it cannot be stepped on or knocked over, and do not train to the point where your form collapses. Never place a device where a fall could injure you.

Accuracy

Hundy verifies repetitions from what the camera can see. Lighting, camera angle, clothing and body position all affect what it can detect, and it will sometimes miss a rep or count one you would have judged differently.

We give you a personal, non-exclusive, non-transferable and revocable licence to use Hundy on devices you own or control, in line with the usage rules of the store you got it from. You may not copy, modify, resell or redistribute the app, or reverse-engineer it except where the law allows you to. Hundy includes open-source software, which is licensed under its own terms. The app itself — its code, design and artwork — belongs to Nexoma Labs.

Your data

Your workouts are stored only on your device. You are responsible for your own backups; if you delete the app, lose the device or clear its data without a device backup, your history is gone and cannot be recovered by anyone.

Acceptable use

Do not use Hundy to record or analyse anyone who has not agreed to it. Do not attempt to falsify verified rep counts, particularly once competitive features exist — the entire value of a camera-verified number is that it is honest.
